text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in mild red territory over the past day, with Ethereum's 1.6% decline slightly outpacing Bitcoin's 1.2% loss, suggesting modest risk-off sentiment among altcoin holders. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral 50 but has dropped 13 points over the week, indicating a gradual shift from mild optimism toward caution. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 59.4% combined with $76B in daily volume shows the market remains engaged rather than capitulating, though neither major is finding strong directional conviction at these levels.
